verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is the Public API doc, which says organizations can manage "policies" through it. That confirms Bitwarden has an org-level policy capability, but the pack never names the specific policies in the story. missing for 10: documented app-lock/vault-timeout enforcement policy, export-restriction policy, master-password-strength requirement policy, evidence that policies apply across every member's client apps, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an IT admin, I can enforce org-wide policies — require app lock, restrict export, mandate strong master credentials — across every member's app

citations.quote: The Bitwarden Public API provides organizations a suite of tools for managing members, collections, groups, event logs, and policies.
